verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a REST API to programmatically access and act on data, including creating issues and a recently added GET /task-statuses endpoint. It also offers webhooks and an official MCP server that can read and update issues, accounts and contacts. Nothing claims or shows UI/API parity, and the MCP scope covers only a few object types; the incremental endpoint additions in the changelog suggest coverage is still being filled in. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity claim or endpoint coverage across all UI features (triggers, analytics, knowledge base, agents/skills configuration, custom objects/fields), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
